title: Garden and Tide
author: I. M. Vane
blurb: Jude Dravenmoor, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
